caption: The drawing features two horizontally aligned panels on a light beige background. The upper panel displays three green, irregularly shaped clusters with blue outlines and some interior yellow shading, connected by a curling, blue vine-like structure that sprawls across the space, with a horizontal blue wavy line and fringe pattern below. The lower, larger panel depicts four pairs of riders and horses in profile facing left. The horses alternate in color between a muted green and a muted black, with blue lines across their necks. Each rider sits upright and wears a black hat, peach-colored clothing with detailed texture, and has a visible facial profile with dark features. Both the upper and lower panels are bordered below by a short, wavy blue fringe or ground pattern. The signature "John Oster" is written in the lower right corner beneath the lower panel. The composition is orderly, with deliberate spacing between riders and an absence of background scenery.
title: Crewel Embroidery
